result.instructions: Tools for BounceBan, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Check my BounceBan verification credits and rate limits."; "Verify this email and read the existing task if it is still pending."; "Submit a list for bulk verification and check its progress.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BounceBan data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bounceban_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bounceban_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bounceban_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. bounceban_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bounceban_account
tools.title: Read BounceBan credits and rate limits
tools.description: Read verification credit balance and account rate limits without starting verification. Limits and credit balance are shared across the account's API keys.

annotations.title: Read BounceBan credits and rate limits

tools.name: bounceban_verify_email
tools.title: Start BounceBan email verification
tools.description: Verify one email in regular mode. Costs verification credits on each request, including repeats, and requires confirm:true. Uses the standard API's 15-second result window; returns a final result or a queue/verifying task ID. Read that existing ID with bounceban_single_status later. Never resubmit simply because it is still pending. Basic-only mode can return unknown with score -1 for catch-all/SEG-protected addresses.

tools.name: bounceban_single_status
tools.title: Read a BounceBan single verification
tools.description: Read an existing single verification ID without spending verification credits. Returns success, verifying or queue. Honor try_again_at when provided; poll no more than 10 times for an ID within 5 minutes, then stop. Results remain available for 90 days. This tool never starts another verification.

tools.name: bounceban_create_bulk_verification
tools.title: Create a BounceBan bulk verification
tools.description: Submit 1–1,000 emails for regular-mode asynchronous verification. Starts a task and can consume verification credits; requires confirm:true. Check the dashboard before resubmitting after a lost/invalid response. greylisting_bypass:auto balances speed and accuracy; speed may yield more risky results; robust waits longer. No callbacks or automatic polling are configured.

tools.name: bounceban_bulk_status
tools.title: Read BounceBan bulk task progress
tools.description: Read progress and aggregate results of an existing bulk task. Does not start verification. Wait between polls and honor account rate limits. importing/verifying status is still pending; finished means the task has ended.

tools.name: bounceban_bulk_results
tools.title: Read one page of BounceBan bulk results
tools.description: Read up to 100 existing email results and a cursor for the next page. Results are retained for 90 days. No verification is started and no following page is fetched automatically. Omit state to get all processed results while a task is running; filtering by state can omit in-progress results. A pending response means wait and check the existing task later.

annotations.title: Read one page of BounceBan bulk results
